environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) a custom rule group 'app-query-sanitization' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*)` with action TERMINATE/BLOCK, priority 50. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group evaluation order and that sampled requests show blocks on SQLi patterns. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs) enforced via a restrictive security group on the ENI (egress only to pl-63a5400a on 443).
